description: Source code for a WebUSB-enabled custom class driver in Zephyr RTOS, supporting WebUSB functionality over USB with custom request handling, endpoint configuration, and device status management.

methods.name: webusb_custom_handle_req
methods.description: Handles standard requests to return WebUSB Platform Capability Descriptor or delegate to custom handler.

methods.name: webusb_vendor_handle_req
methods.description: Handles WebUSB vendor-specific requests or delegates to vendor handler.

methods.name: webusb_register_request_handlers
methods.description: Registers custom and vendor request callback handlers for WebUSB.

methods.name: webusb_write_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked after data is written to an endpoint.

methods.name: webusb_read_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked after data is read from an endpoint, initiates next transfer.

methods.name: webusb_dev_status_cb
methods.description: Handles USB device status changes, such as connect, disconnect, reset, suspend, resume.
